logo.purpose: The BuyTune.io logo text exclusively — Syne, nowhere else.

mono.purpose: Every price, percent, count, and score in the product.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a screen — gradient-filled, glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3fae4a, #0ea5a0); color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(14,165,160,0.25); transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(14,165,160,0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0ea5a0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — quiet surface, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: oklch(0.985 0.01 150); color: oklch(0.4 0.03 150); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(20,30,20,0.13); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(20,30,20,0.045); color: oklch(0.2 0.03 150); }

components.name: Signal Card
components.description: The default content container — flat, hairline-bordered, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(0.985 0.01 150); border: 1px solid rgba(20,30,20,0.13); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.48 0.03 150); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 22px; color: oklch(0.2 0.03 150); }

components.name: Signal Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-chip-up { background: rgba(22,163,74,0.09); color: #16a34a; border-color: rgba(22,163,74,0.22); } .ds-chip-down { background: rgba(220,38,38,0.09); color: #dc2626; border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.24); }

components.name: Action Badge
components.description: BUY/SELL/TRIM/HOLD tags on AI recommendation rows.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-buy { background: rgba(22,163,74,0.09); color: #16a34a; border: 1px solid rgba(22,163,74,0.22); } .ds-badge-sell { background: rgba(220,38,38,0.09); color: #dc2626; border: 1px solid rgba(220,38,38,0.24); } .ds-badge-trim { background: rgba(200,121,30,0.08); color: #c8791e; border: 1px solid rgba(200,121,30,0.25); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Dark-panel nav row, active state gets a green-tinted pill.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.62 0.02 150); } .ds-nav-active { font-weight: 600; color: #c9f2c9; background: rgba(63,174,74,0.2); }

narrative.overview: BuyTune's Sage system reads as a warm, daylight-lit workspace for a serious financial decision, not a trading-floor monitor or a spreadsheet. The palette is a soft sage-green ground, close in value to warm paper, with ink-dark text and a single green-to-teal gradient reserved for the moments that matter: primary actions, active navigation, the logo mark. Cards sit flat on the ground, separated by hairline borders rather than shadows — nothing floats, nothing glows except on interaction. The one true dark surface is the sidebar/footer/CTA-band family, which acts as punctuation: a dark edge that frames the light workspace rather than a competing dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: Warm sage background (oklch(0.9 0.042 150)), brightening through card/elevated tiers toward near-white
Single green→teal brand gradient (#3fae4a → #0ea5a0), reserved for CTAs, active nav, and the logo
Flat cards at rest: 1px hairline ink-tinted borders, no ambient shadow
One true dark surface family (sidebar, footer, CTA bands) — a fixed frame, not a dark mode
DM Sans for display/body/label text; DM Mono for every number; Syne only in the wordmark
Signal colors are semantic only — never decorative

rules.name: The Gradient Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The green→teal gradient appears only on primary CTAs, active nav, and the logo mark — never behind or adjacent to a gain/loss number.

rules.name: The One Dark Surface Rule
rules.body: There is no dark mode. The dark-panel family is a fixed structural element, not a theme.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value renders in DM Mono, never DM Sans.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Only Rule
rules.body: Syne appears in exactly one place: the BuyTune.io logo text.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards carry a border, not a shadow, at rest. Shadow appears only in response to state.

rules.name: The Dark-Frame Rule
rules.body: Dark-panel surfaces are structural, not elevational — they frame the workspace, they don't sit in the tonal stack.

dos: Do use DM Mono for every price, percentage, count, and score, without exception.
Do keep the brand gradient to CTAs, active nav, and the logo — nowhere else.
Do pair signal colors with a +/− sign or label, never color alone.
Do use flat cards with a 1px hairline border as the default container.
Do treat the dark-panel family as a fixed structural frame present on every screen.
Do size touch targets at 44px minimum on mobile.
donts: Don't build a meme-stock casino — no rocket emojis, no dopamine loops, no 'to the moon' energy.
Don't build a Bloomberg terminal — no dense unstructured data dumps.
Don't copy a dated brokerage portal — no gray-on-gray, no lifeless typography.
Don't use the Excel aesthetic — no clinical monochrome.
Don't use gamification patterns — no streaks-as-pressure, no push-notification anxiety culture.
Don't reintroduce dark mode or a second dark surface.
Don't use border-left wider than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use Syne anywhere but the wordmark.
Don't put the brand gradient behind or adjacent to a numeric gain/loss value.
